smell: Header.level is bare S.Int with no 1..6 range check while Md headings are a closed 1|2|3|4|5|6 domain.
proposedTarget: Keep as-is. The breadth is load-bearing: the model mirrors Pandoc's Haskell `Header Int` wire type, and the pandoc-to-md projection explicitly represents out-of-range levels so it can clamp them and emit a lossy compatibility issue (pandocHeadingLevelProjection, Pandoc.mapping.ts:327-341). Tightening to 1..6 would turn a reportable compatibility gap into a whole-document decode failure.

exception.reason: Third-party wire mirror whose out-of-range values are an explicit, tested compatibility-report path (clamp + lossy issue); range-checking the model would delete the gap-reporting behavior the package exists to provide.
exception.boundary: Pandoc JSON wire (Header constructor payload, Pandoc.codec.ts:430-436) and the pandoc-to-md clamp at Pandoc.mapping.ts:308-341

smell: OrderedList.start is bare S.Int with no non-negativity or range check.
proposedTarget: Keep as-is. Pandoc's ListAttributes start is a plain Int (negative and zero starts are representable in the wire), and the mapping already detects non-default markers (start !== 1) to emit a lossy issue (hasOrderedListMarkerLoss, Pandoc.mapping.ts:74-75). A range check would reject representable Pandoc documents instead of reporting them.

exception.reason: Third-party wire mirror of Pandoc ListAttributes; unusual starts are compatibility-report data, not invalid input.

smell: PandocMeta is a broad S.Record(S.String, S.Unknown) on the root document model.
proposedTarget: Keep as-is.
